player_prompt.intro:
I ka kɛlɛ kɔrɔ Minesweeper jɛɛ.
Jɛɛ ɲinin bɛ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ fɛ, a bɛ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ taa wɛrɛ wɛrɛ ka miiri tɛmɛnna.
I ka kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ fɛ, i koo kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ:
- `[row col]`: Jɛɛ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ.
Kɔrɔɔri:
- `[3 2]` jɛɛ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ ka taa Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` jɛɛ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ ka taa Row 5, Column 6.
I ka kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ fɛ, i ka kɛlɛ kɔrɔ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ ka taa kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ.
Kɔrɔɔri bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ ka sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ, a bɛ kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ.
Kɔrɔɔri bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ ka sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ:

invalid_move.wrong_format: I ma a yira ko i ka jaabili ye tiɲɛn ye.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: O kɔ fɛ, a ka kan k'a yira ko sira ni bere tɛ kelen ye.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Kɛŋɛla tɔɔ la ({row}, {col}) yɛrɛ don niŋa.
invalid_move.hit_mine: I ka kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ ka miiri ({row}, {col}).

game_action.revealed: I ka kɛlɛ kɔrɔ bɔɲɛ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ i n'a fɔ ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: A barika! A ka Minesweeper ka bɔnɛ kɔrɔw ye.
outcome.turn_limit: Kɛlɛ ka sɔrɔ kɔrɔw ye ka fɔlɔ. A ka {percent}% ka bɔnɛ kɔrɔw ye.
